svg.title: The boot arc: where #2 stopped, and what this branch measures
svg.desc: The left panel is the state at #2: the vendor installer reaches userspace under the profile, finds no disk because the guest walks the configuration window its own ACPI names and the profile did not back it, the hardware fan evidence is a read while the model answers reads and writes, and the runtime service is unanswered. No installed disk existed yet, so the silent-kernel run belongs to this branch rather than to #2. The right panel is this branch: the ECAM and the declared ITS are backed so both NVMe controllers enumerate, init_restore writes the root, the installed 7.0.0-1019 kernel boots the restored disk under the vendor UEFI, getty reaches a login prompt, Secure Boot is enforced with a lab key hierarchy while the module signing key travels through shim, a lab-identity build of the fan module binds the FF-A packet service and publishes through hwmon, and a runtime variable created through the real STMM survives into a cold boot that selects it. The band below lists what the branch does not establish.
svg.text: The boot arc, from the installer to a login prompt
Left: the state at #2. Right: what this branch measures, each row with the record that carries it.
At #2
installer reaches userspace
Run /init as init process, FastOS 1.155.49 banner
under the emulated vendor UEFI
no disk, and the reason is named
the guest walks PCIF: segment 15, ECAM 0x29000000;
the profile backed the segment 0-14 window only
hardware fan evidence: reads measured
the model answers reads and writes; on a unit only a
read was taken, and no write has ever been exercised
the runtime service is unanswered
efivars mount fails; no runtime variable can be created
No installed disk existed at this point, so there was nothing
to boot: the silent-kernel run is this branch's, not #2's.
This branch
the window the ACPI names is backed
ECAM 0x29000000 and the declared ITS; both NVMe enumerate
the installer writes a real disk
init_restore: 37 GB root, e2fsck, resize2fs, new UUID, fstab
the installed kernel boots that disk
firmware, EFI/BOOT on p1, shim, GRUB, 7.0.0-1019 on p2
a login prompt, as root
systemd 255.4 to multi-user and graphical.target; login prompt
Secure Boot enforced, with the taint named
lab PK/KEK by authenticated update; shim brokered the MOK
fan and runtime variables, in the guest
lab-identity module binds 0x8003; entry survives a cold boot
What the branch does not establish
SMMU: three declared windows read zero, so arm-smmu-v3 fails probe with -ENXIO; ruled out as the deferral's cause, not modelled.
eSPI: no boot reaches the bus. ROT: two request shapes are known, the reply is assumed.
Hardware: no unit running 2.158.15 or 4.1.0 was available for this validation; the path stays lab-only until one is.
Fan RPM: published values are duty-derived estimates, not a tachometer; the readback is not blade speed.
